what_this_is: The presentation film, described by the sources that build it. Every field below is derived from presentation/src at generation time rather than read from a document, so nothing written by hand can disagree with it about the same film.

beats.name: Hello
beats.narration: Somewhere tonight, a team is waiting to hear from a satellite they built. For 4 minutes it passes overhead, and a volunteer with an antenna in a back garden records everything it says. This is that recording. And this, this is everything anyone ever wrote down about it. with-signal. Two words.

beats.name: Title
beats.narration: And it is one of two thousand seven hundred and twenty seven. TraceTriage is what decides which of them a person opens first.

beats.name: Problem
beats.narration: Now, only seven hundred and thirty nine of them carry a human verdict. The rest were kept, and never read. Not because nobody cared. Because there is no order to work through them in.

beats.name: Physics
beats.narration: So we stop guessing, and measure. A satellite coming toward you raises the frequency you hear, and lowers it as it leaves. The orbit predicts that curve, spanning seventeen thousand two hundred and ninety hertz. Slide it one hundred and thirteen pixels and it lands on the trace. That gap is a measurement, not an opinion. plus thirty two point zero five parts per million. This station had already corrected for Doppler. Nothing in the record says so.

beats.name: Queue
beats.narration: That is what the queue ranks on. four hundred and seven observations against a budget of 50. Not the loudest. The ones where the evidence disagrees with itself.

beats.name: Live
beats.narration: All of that was frozen in August. Here is the live console measuring one now. Of 10 quantities, 8 match the archived digits exactly.

beats.name: Flow
beats.narration: And you can drive the same evidence from a LangFlow canvas. Watch. A sentence goes in carrying a frequency this observation does not have. One take, no cut. The checker refuses it, and names why.

beats.name: Session
beats.narration: And there it is. ungrounded number. That is the same checker that decides whether our own generated notes ship.

beats.name: Result
beats.narration: Now, the part demos skip. Six gates, with thresholds, written down before anything was measured. The headline one wanted half again as many conflicts as random. This queue found 20 of them. Random ordering, at the same budget, expects 12.6. We publish that as not established.

beats.name: Gates
beats.narration: So, the point estimate is 1.58, and the interval straddles the bar, so it fails here. 3 of 6 gates met, and nothing was moved.

beats.name: Established
beats.narration: But three did come back decided. Evidence tools take a local Granite model from 2 of 24 right to 22. The checker caught every one of five hundred and twenty five planted falsehoods. And on stations the queue never saw, lift clears at 2.25.

beats.name: Bob
beats.narration: And IBM Bob built the load-bearing pipeline. Contracts, snapshot, parser, corridor, baselines, queue. 10 dated units, each naming what it changed and what failed first.

beats.name: Colophon
beats.narration: Every figure you just heard came out of a receipt. The waterfall is public, cited and licensed.

beats.name: Thanks
beats.narration: That is TraceTriage. Nothing in it asks to be believed. Thank you for watching.

what_this_does_not_measure: Whether the film is any good, or whether a viewer follows it.
Whether the rendered file plays. The digests say only that the committed bytes are the bytes this receipt was written about.

Whether the numbers are right. They are the receipts' own numbers, and each receipt's own study is what establishes them. This receipt establishes only that the film reads them rather than restating them.
